# Standpoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Standpoint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

A named perspective / frame within which claims are held true — a state's official position, a community's usage, an editorial or historiographic point of view. Minted only when the frame needs its own identity and labels; often a bare [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) (a polity, an organization) suffices as the value of [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) instead. Standpoints form a poset under [`gmeow:sharpens`](../properties/gmeow-sharpens.md), topped by [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Standpoint`](gmeow-Standpoint.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
